title: Vanishing of ∫ Dh(x − s y)(y) g(|y|²) dy for harmonic h and 0 < s ≤ 1
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝⁿ (= Euclid n) be open, and let h : ℝⁿ → ℝ be C² on U with Δh(y) := Σ_{i<n} D²h(y)(e_i, e_i) = 0 for all y ∈ U, where D²h(y)(a, b) = iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 h y ![a, b] and e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1. Let x ∈ ℝⁿ and 0 < r < R with closedBall(x, R) ⊆ U, let g : ℝ → ℝ be continuous with g(t) = 0 for all t ≥ r², and let 0 < s ≤ 1. Then ∫_{ℝⁿ} Dh(x − s y)(y)·g(|y|²) dy = 0, where Dh(z) = fderiv ℝ h z.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid n)) (h : Euclid n → ℝ), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 h U → (∀ y ∈ U, ∑ i : Fin n, iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 h y ![EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)] = 0) → ∀ (x : Euclid n) (r R : ℝ), 0 < r → r < R → closedBall x R ⊆ U → ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous g → (∀ t : ℝ, r ^ 2 ≤ t → g t = 0) → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ 1 → ∫ y : Euclid n, fderiv ℝ h (x - s • y) y * g (‖y‖ ^ 2) = 0
